page.overview:
What is Moag?

Moag is a backwater plane where Urza and Xantcha settled on while kept out of Dominaria by the Shard.

Moag is a hospitable world with abundant, rich soil, a broad swath of temperate climates, and a wealth of vigorous cultures. It is bright and pastoral as well as being a metal-rich world.

While Urza and Xantcha were hiding from the Phyrexians, the two companions settled on Moag, 650 AR. 30 years later, after Xantcha discovered Phyrexians had infiltrated a fire god's cult, Urza and Xantcha chose to leave the plane with the Phyrexians in tow in order to keep them from plundering the metal-rich soil for Phyrexia's needs.

During New Phyrexia's Invasion of the Multiverse, the plane was again invaded by Phyrexians. Only the trees were old enough to remember what had happened when Moag ignored warnings of Phyrexia millennia ago. They were determined not to repeat the mistake.
